title.value: High-Order Pooling for Graph Neural Networks with Tensor Decomposition

title.quote: High-Order Pooling for Graph Neural Networks with Tensor Decomposition

extractions.description: The paper introduces Tensorized Graph Neural Network (tGNN), a GNN architecture that uses tensor decomposition to model high-order non-linear node interactions for improved performance in graph-structured data modeling.
